verdict.rationale: skills.sh has no sandbox or test environment as such. The closest evidence is `skills use`, which writes the selected skill files to a temporary directory and prints the generated prompt instead of installing into the project. `--list` also lets you inspect a repository's skills without installing them. Together these give a glancing way to trial skills without altering a real project setup. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test environment, isolation from production data or credentials, sandboxed execution of bundled skill scripts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
